description: Closed typed current-state families derived from authority-committed Events. Selectors are domain types, never alternate current state IDs. Each row also records its CONSUMPTION: consumption.class is one of the consumption_classes below, consumption.consumed_by names the zh prose sections that read the current value, and consumption.note says what is read and to decide what. check_every_state_family_has_a_writer closes the writer direction; this ledger is the reader direction, which had no gate and no record. consumed_by is non-empty for every class except record_only, and a record_only row's note MUST name the section that states the family's purpose so the classification is checkable rather than an absence of evidence. Citations resolve through check_artifact_prose_section_refs.

consumption_classes.admission_input: Reading the current value can change whether an Event or request is accepted or authorized.
consumption_classes.delivery_input: Reading the current value shapes what a service surface returns or delivers, or what a conforming client must do, but never decides admission.
consumption_classes.record_only: No v1 prose reads this value to decide anything; it exists as an audit or display record. This class MUST be declared explicitly -- a family nobody happens to mention is not thereby record_only.

consumption.note: A first grant's issuer ceiling and the whole issuer-authority chain are computed from the current authority root, so reading it decides whether a grant is accepted.
Directory results and exact resolve draw the Realm metadata they may disclose from this projection; the preview policy bounds which of its fields are released.

The Realm membership FSM reads the current member state to decide which membership transitions are accepted; parent_membership also reads source authoritative current membership in the co-governing Station's accepting transaction. Circle join admission and effective Circle membership compare its revision with the Circle join's parent_membership_revision.
Writes against a Strand take its current projection as their basis, so admission of Strand-scoped Events reads it.
Remove-wins folding and the anti-abuse rules both evaluate against the current reaction set.
The single-group and repair rules read the current MLS group projection to decide whether a commit or welcome is accepted.
Agent runtime pairing and session authorization are decided against the currently authorized agent keys.
A paused or deactivated agent principal is rejected on the admission path, which reads this projection.
The realm_id is derived from the genesis Event and self-certifying; resolvers check the claim against this projection.
The cross-field rule admits a scope's first history-bearing write only while the current history_access is since_join.
The current principal and unique PCR of an authenticated account are read from this projection when admitting identity-bound operations.
accountable_principal_ids is verifiable only through this endorsement projection; without it the dependent Actor operations are not admissible.
The effective permission set is computed from the current grant projection on every authorization decision.
The state machine decides each next call Event against the current call state.
Focus selection and session persistence read the committed focus before a media token is issued.
Whether a recording start or stop is admissible is decided against the current recording state.
The summary's recording_state is mirrored from this projection and the reducer validates the summary against it.
Whether a transcript start or stop is admissible is decided against the current transcript state.
The summary's transcript_state is mirrored from this projection and the reducer validates the summary against it.
restore_participant may only lift an active ban of the same actor, which is decided against the current moderation projection.
Participant identity cross-checking on the media side resolves against the current roster.
crypto-media/call-state.md §4.1 retains this shape only for contract bookkeeping; v1 rejects every mute_override write and no token issuer or SFU may consume it as media authority.
morph_kind_profiles narrows a Morph's facets, writable fields and required capability, and validation reads it.

Link state drives link-graph and navigation semantics only; it never propagates membership, capability, policy, retention, or notification state. An active join_gate_from row is a required local admission input for co-governed parent_membership, not a membership carrier.
Entry-rule evaluation reads the current join rule.
Whether the directory indexes and returns a Realm is decided by its current discoverability declaration.
resolve_realm and the namespace-occupancy check both resolve against the current alias projection.
The governance binding decides media-service authority against the bundle's current value; join admission reads the same current bundle before evaluating parent_membership.
Whether a presign, a server-side thumbnail or a proxy download is permitted is decided against this policy.
A service DID that decrypts media MUST appear in this projection; otherwise the request fails with media_plaintext_service_not_authorised.
Token exchange and focus selection read the declared media services before issuing anything.
Scope-local disclosure and visibility govern receipt sending and rendering only inside the exact signed Realm/Circle scope; no parent or sibling policy participates.
Preview-token acceptance runs against the effective policy digest allowlist, and the response is trimmed to the fields this policy allows.
The terminal state decides what the Realm still admits after it is reached.
The terminal state decides what the Realm still admits after it is reached.
A client MUST identify the default discussion Strand through this pointer or its derived is_default flag, never through an implementation detail.
The structural container move constraint decides a move against the Strand's current from/to container refs.
The invite state machine decides accept, claim, cancel and revoke against the current lifecycle value.
Whether an invite still has a live target is a precondition the same behaviour rules read.
A directed invite may only be accepted by the recorded invitee, which those rules resolve from this projection.
A reader folds the dot set into the current pin list and reads asserter and polarity from each dot's signed envelope.
The causal parent edge decides whether a Space-hierarchy write holds.
Whether a child Space's scope narrowing is admissible is decided against this policy.
The Agent PCR genesis construction order is checked against the provisioning facts recorded here.
It is the reverse index of the same fact: entry-1 admission starts from a serviceEndpoint realm_id and resolves the agent_id through this projection.
Message submission through the MIMI facade is admitted against the current room binding.
Validating an E2EE abuse report's evidence package reads the franking proof.
The moderation queue View returns the accepted report and folds its two-state status from this family plus the dismiss records in moderation_state.
The (controller principal, agent_slug) claim binds an already-known exact Agent AccountId; it may verify a disclosed picker label but cannot resolve a free-text mention or grant a new read.
The receiving policy decides whether a DM or invite may be delivered and accepted against the holder's current consent record.
The hard_deny / quarantine / require_review fold over active records participates in the authorization decision; capabilities.md 18.1 binds fast-path cache invalidation to the same value.
The redaction assertion set folds into which content slots are still visible; it does not change admission.

Organization-level moderation policy is one global current state per Organization DID. Production writes and dependent cross-Realm reads fail closed until the unique authenticated policy authority Realm binding and verified source Commit carrier exist; no arrival-order winner is permitted.
Query surfaces render against the current View value; a View grants no permission and never decides admission.
rules[] evaluation and default_effect run inside this document's current value, and deny / quarantine / require_review change admission directly.
The approval configuration's hit conditions, vote counting, rejection shape and default are defined there; it can only tighten a decision that is already ALLOWED, never grant.
The current binding is the authority basis for day-to-day Events inside a direct conversation.

The approving device of an accepted_device pairing MUST itself be an active, unrevoked device at the current generation, and a keys/query row is issued only after its authorization window is checked against this result. It is also the join target of the device_status fold and of account_device signer evidence.

Every ak.device.authorize is admitted only if its authorized_generation_ref equals this value, every ak.device.reanchor only if its previous_device_generation does; and a keys/query row is refused when the device's generation does not match it. Managed PCR genesis initializes this value to the literal 1 through its accepted ak.realm.create, without a Device row. Replay and same-cut integrity checks include that original create/Commit; authorize/replacement and DID/Service epoch changes never initialize or reset it.

The revocation-pending gate on new live authorization reads this set, and the SecurityRotationTransaction of §2.2 resumes from the element it created. Folding it against the covering command result is what yields revoked / rejected.

The object's own current value. Its state member gates every later write on the object: a lifecycle write checks the pre-state and an ordinary write is refused while the object is not active, so reading it decides admission.

The single current Relation value for one primary_conflict_domain, also carried by complete Realm Snapshots when its source scope and both endpoint references are disclosable. create/update/tombstone compare its exact revision and lifecycle before writing; its event-derived RelationId remains in the value for stable history and object references.

While true, every non-exempt ordinary write into the Realm is refused with realm_frozen (HTTP 403); the closed exemption set is in the same section. A archived Realm still accepts the exempt kinds, and lifting this gate lifts nothing else.

While true, every non-exempt ordinary write into the Realm is refused with realm_frozen (HTTP 403); the closed exemption set is in the same section. A frozen Realm still accepts the exempt kinds, and lifting this gate lifts nothing else.

The global display value the authorized read operation ak.self.actor_profile.read.resolve.v1 serves beside the exact signed profile Event and its covering RealmCommit. The pair proves accepted provenance but grants no identity, capability or membership authority and does not prove projection completeness.
Publishing the exact pre-authored Event reads the immutable controller confirmation and nonce binding.
Authorized Sidecar participants decrypt and fold the control assertion set into coordinator and terminal exchange state.
Directory indexing reads the Applet self-declared discovery value.
Exact Realm/Applet/Service registration snapshot and signed CAS basis. Independent Services coexist; managed actor ownership comes only from accepted creation/current manager, never a DID namespace.
Successor version admission and recovery-list selection read the current series pointer.
Client sync folds verified replacement edges into the current member identity display segment.
Message materialization reads creation history and the current revision carrier, with redaction applied separately.
Authorized profile resolution overlays this Realm-local display patch on the global Actor Profile.
Organization views and official-badge rendering read the latest verified relationship statement.

Circle join, knock, leave and ban transitions read the exact per-Circle Actor membership and its CAS basis. Effective Circle membership, the MLS send and Add gate for parent-invalidated leaves, and the Circle readable floor and historical-cut membership read the join value's parent_membership_revision against the parent Realm member_state current in the same cut.
Index upload and search service admission read the current Realm allowlist, data classes and leakage profile.
Calendar views deliver each responder's current whole-series or occurrence-specific response.
Schema-bound object admission resolves the immutable definition occupying the referenced schema id.
Sidecar UI placement resolves the latest versioned attachment for each exact source context.
Sidecar-scoped admission reads existence, controller, Realm and lifecycle state before accepting private-stream Events.
Notification dispatch and authorized watcher projection read the exact per-Strand Actor watch value.
Exact current Realm mode gates shared Agent producer/executor actions and directed third-party delivery; it never grants capability or changes Sidecar participants.
Own-Station current source and minimal encrypted metadata context permit authorized current schedule reconstruction below history floor. No schedule plaintext predicate is an admission gate.
